pattern: \bbulk cable|cable TV is the largest item, then trash
struck: Bulk cable TV is the largest item, then trash pickup, the management contract, landscaping and ponds.
use: The largest item in the 2026 budget is cable TV, 38.5 percent of $2,031,964, then landscaping and ponds, trash pickup, the management contract, electricity, a reserve contribution, the pools and insurance.

struck: D.R. Horton handed control of the HOA board to the owners on August 1, 2019.
use: D.R. Horton ended its right to appoint a majority of the HOA board in July and August 2019.

struck: The covenant section for a beach club was deleted in 2017.
use: The Declaration's beach club section was deleted by an amendment recorded in January 2018.

struck: Its streets are county roads, so the HOA cannot add speed bumps on its own.
use: The Farm is not gated, and its roads are county-owned.

struck: The nearest public beach accesses by car are City of Myrtle Beach accesses about 10 minutes and 4.6 to 4.7 miles away.
use: Public beach accesses in Myrtle Beach are about 10 minutes and under 5 miles by car from the Farmers Rest Drive entrance.

struck: The big shopping centers nearest Carolina Forest: Tanger Outlets on Highway 501 is about 13 minutes.
use: Tanger Outlets on Highway 501 is about 13 minutes and 8 miles by car, and Coastal Grand Mall about 15 minutes and 8 miles.

struck: The new 48-bed hospital is open.
use: McLeod Health says its 48-bed McLeod Carolina Forest Hospital, on the same campus as its emergency department, is scheduled to open in fall 2026.

struck: On 2026-10-13, 14 homes in The Farm were listed for sale, from $229,000 to $510,999.
use: 16 homes for sale on 2026-10-13, from $229,000 to $510,999: 15 detached houses and 1 Orchards townhouse.

struck: The board may set a minimum lease term of six months.
use: Owners may rent their homes; leases must be in writing and a copy with the tenants' names and phone numbers goes to the manager within 10 days.

struck: The 2024 rules list a $150 non-refundable fee and a $250 refundable deposit to reserve the activity center.
use: Owners can reserve the activity center for up to four hours for a private event, for a fee.

struck: Zone X is not one. A lender may still ask for it.
use: Federal law requires flood insurance on a mortgage from a federally regulated lender when the home is in a special flood hazard area.

pattern: \bdedicated to the Lewis Ocean Bay Heritage Preserve on|\b(?:preserve|tract) is (?:now )?open to the public
struck: SCDNR acquired the tract and dedicated to the Lewis Ocean Bay Heritage Preserve on June 10, 2025.
use: The S.C. Department of Natural Resources bought a 353-acre tract on The Farm's northern side and says it will be dedicated as part of the Lewis Ocean Bay Heritage Preserve and open for outdoor recreation.

struck: The county's International Drive Fields, at 900 International Drive next to The Farm.
use: The county's International Drive Fields at 900 International Drive are about 5 minutes and under 2 miles by car from the Farmers Rest Drive entrance.

struck: The 15 percent cap on reassessment increases does not apply that year.
use: The new value first appears on the tax bill for the year after the sale.

pattern: \bcleanup work there is done|\bwhich runs the program
struck: Response complete means the cleanup work there is done. The Defense Department, which runs the program, explains those words.
use: Response complete means the cleanup work there is finished, although the Defense Department or a later owner may keep monitoring the site. The Defense Department, which sets the program's terms, explains those words.

pattern: \bsite closeout means|\bno more cleanup money will be spent|\bcan be used without limits
struck: Site closeout means the land can be used without limits. No more cleanup money will be spent there.
use: On its map, the Corps lists every home in The Farm as on land with the status 'Response Complete and Site Closeout'.

pattern: \bin a different part of Carolina Forest|\bCorps is still working
struck: The Corps is still working on another section, called Range III, in a different part of Carolina Forest.
use: The Corps lists another section, called Range III, as still under investigation. It borders The Farm.

struck: Every street in The Farm is inside all three zones.
use: Every home in The Farm is inside all three zones, so every home has the same three schools.

struck: The Farm, in orange, with the school zone lines: blue for Ocean Bay Elementary, purple for Ocean Bay Middle and yellow for Carolina Forest High.
use: The Farm, in orange, with the school zones: a blue line for Ocean Bay Elementary, purple shading for Ocean Bay Middle and yellow shading for Carolina Forest High.

struck: D.R. Horton recorded its HOA rules in 2004 and recorded its last two sections, Phases 23B and 21, in 2017.
use: D.R. Horton recorded its HOA rules in 2004 and added land in stages until 2017, when the last two sections, Phases 23B and 21, were added.

pattern: \bsquare feet, on a lot of about a fifth of an acre
struck: Both one-story and two-story houses are for sale here. Most have about 1,450 to 3,200 square feet, on a lot of about a fifth of an acre.
use: Most have about 1,450 to 3,200 square feet. A typical house lot is about a fifth of an acre.

pattern: \bholds about 7,400 square feet|7,400 square feet of water
struck: The large pool holds about 7,400 square feet of water.
use: The large pool covers about 7,400 square feet [county building footprint of the in-ground pool].

struck: Its wide deck faces a pond, and the activity center is about 400 feet away.
use: Its wide deck is beside a pond, and the activity center is about 400 feet away.

struck: Houses here usually sell for about $350,000.
use: Houses in The Farm sold for a middle price of about $352,000 in the 12 months to September 2026, with half between $307,500 and $388,000.

pattern: \bTownhomes and condos usually sell for about \$230,000
struck: Townhomes and condos usually sell for about $230,000 to $240,000.
use: Orchards townhomes sold for a middle price of $228,500 (13 sales) and Planters Point condos for $237,500 (9 sales) in the 12 months to September 2026.

pattern: \bplan on about \$2,600 a year to own it
struck: Beyond the mortgage and home insurance, plan on about $2,600 a year to own it.
use: For a $350,000 house you live in, the HOA fee and the county property tax come to about $2,600 a year, beyond the mortgage and home insurance. The county adds a stormwater fee of about $90.

struck: State preserve land borders its north edge.
use: Land the state bought for the Lewis Ocean Bay Heritage Preserve borders its north edge. The state says it will be dedicated as part of the preserve and open for outdoor recreation.

pattern: \bmedical center was once planned|\bonce planned a large medical center
struck: Conway Medical Center once planned a large medical center on that land.
use: Conway Medical Center had meant the land for a $160 million healthcare facility.

pattern: \bfee includes two pools, a fitness room
struck: The $107 HOA fee includes two pools, a fitness room, cable TV and trash pickup.
use: The $107 HOA fee pays for the pools, cable TV and trash pickup. Owners can use the HOA's fitness room.

struck: Every year, The Farm also joins other Carolina Forest neighborhoods in a food drive.
use: The Farm is one of the neighborhoods in the 16th annual Carolina Forest food drive on October 24, 2026.

pattern: \bshare one campus about 3 minutes away by car|\bBike and Run Park, about 4 minutes away
struck: The county library and the Carolina Forest Recreation Center share one campus about 3 minutes away by car.
use: The county library and the Carolina Forest Recreation Center share one campus, about 3 minutes by car from the Farmers Rest Drive entrance.

pattern: \bCorps is still investigating Range III|\bRange III, a section next door
struck: The Corps is still investigating Range III, a section next door.
use: The Corps' 2024 map data lists Range III, a section that borders The Farm, as under investigation.

pattern: \bThe tax is based on about what you pay for the house
struck: The tax is based on about what you pay for the house, and the new amount starts the year after you buy.
use: After you buy, the county sets the home's value at about what a buyer would pay on the open market. In an ordinary sale that is close to the price paid, and the new amount first appears on the tax bill the year after you buy.

pattern: \bThe state keeps (?:it|the preserve) healthy with controlled burns
struck: The state keeps it healthy with controlled burns.
use: The state manages the preserve with controlled burns, which SCDNR says are essential to the preserve's health.

struck: Its parking area is South Carolina's first official East Coast Greenway trailhead.
use: Its parking area is a trailhead on the East Coast Greenway.

pattern: ^It also covers landscaping and the ponds
struck: Cable TV from Spectrum is the largest share of the fee. It also covers landscaping and the ponds, trash pickup and the pools.
use: The fee also covers landscaping and the ponds, trash pickup and the pools.

pattern: \bAt closing, you pay the HOA a one-time fee of \$250
struck: At closing, you pay the HOA a one-time fee of $250.
use: On an ordinary sale, the buyer pays the HOA a one-time $250 transfer fee at closing.

struck: Visitors park and walk its dirt roads.
use: SCDNR asks visitors to park their vehicles and walk the preserve's well-maintained roads [SCDNR Public Lands property page].

struck: Beach 10 min
use: Beach About 10 min by car (and Publix About 2 min by car) [OSRM from the Farmers Rest Drive entrance: 10.1 and 1.5 min].

struck: The fee and the flood map are The Farm's strongest points. The pool repair and the parking rule are its main drawbacks.
use: (cut the opener, or list all four cons: the pool, the parking rule, a second HOA fee for townhomes and condos, and hunting at the preserve; no ranking)

pattern: \bis the part the Corps\b|\bthe part the Corps[^.]{0,40}investigation
struck: Range III, a section that borders The Farm, is the part the Corps still lists as under investigation.
use: Range III, a section that borders The Farm, is listed by the Corps as under investigation [Corps FUDS data, fiscal year 2024].

struck: We will look for the homes for sale that fit and show you any you like.
use: We will look for the homes for sale that fit and set up showings for the ones you choose.

struck: The activity center, about 400 feet from the large pool, is where the HOA board meets each month.
use: The activity center, about 400 feet from the large pool, is where the HOA board usually meets [HOA calendar, January to November 2026: board meetings listed at the activity center in nine of the eleven months; none in August, and the March annual meeting is at the county recreation center].

struck: Hunting is allowed in season: bows from mid-September, guns from October 21 to January 1, and small game to March 1.
use: Hunting is allowed in season: bows from mid-September, muzzleloaders from October 11, other guns from October 21 to January 1, and small game to March 1 [S.C. Code Regs. 123-40, section 1.1 D, item 19, and section 3.2].

struck: If you walk the preserve's roads in the fall, you share them with hunters in season.
use: The preserve allows both hiking and hunting [SCDNR Public Lands data for Lewis Ocean Bay HP and WMA: Hiking Yes, Hunting Yes, no special-activity closure].

pattern: \byou can rent out your home, with no limit\b
struck: Under the HOA rules, you can rent out your home, with no limit on how many homes are rented.
use: Owners can rent their homes with a written lease, and the HOA has no cap on how many homes are rented [HOA Rules and Regulations, Exhibit C, adopted 2011; HOA board minutes, May 18, 2026].

struck: The fitness room is in the HOA's clubhouse, open to owners from 5:30 a.m. to 9 p.m.
use: The fitness room is in the HOA's clubhouse, open to residents from 5:30 a.m. to 9 p.m. [HOA amenity rules, recorded April 2024].

struck: No. The Farm has no gate, and the streets in The Farm are public roads owned by Horry County.
use: No. The Farm is not gated, and its roads are county-owned [HOA FAQ; HOA board minutes, May 18, 2026].
